description: This file defines the XFontStyle struct, representing font style options (Normal, Italic, Oblique) within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for comparison, string conversion, and construction from GDI font styles.

classes.name: XFontStyle
classes.description: Represents the style of a font face, such as normal, italic, or oblique, within PDFsharp. It is a readonly struct implementing IFormattable, providing comparison and string representation functionalities.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Checks equality between two XFontStyle instances.

methods.name: operator !=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two XFontStyle instances.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines whether this instance is equal to another XFontStyle instance.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for this XFontStyle instance.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the font style, such as 'Normal', 'Italic', or 'Oblique'.

methods.name: ConvertToString
methods.description: Internal method converting the style enumeration to its string representation.

methods.name: FromGdiFontStyle
methods.description: Creates an XFontStyle from a GDI font style, mapping specific GDI styles to PDFsharp styles.
